description: T08 (design guidelines §2): every token shows two concentric rings - an inner band in the unit's army colour (FactionRing) and a thin outer ring in the owner's player-slot colour (SlotRing: UIConstants.FRIENDLY_PLAYER_TEAL for P1, ENEMY_PLAYER_MAGENTA for P2) - painted beneath the model art, replacing the old single unit-colour ring. Fixture mirror_custodes_postdeploy: P1 Adeptus Custodes vs P2 Adeptus Custodes, the only fixture with P1 Custodes + P2 Witchseekers (Witchseekers are an Anathema Psykana unit of the Custodes army, so P2's colours come from the Custodes palette too - no 'Witchseekers blue' exists in army data). Setup privilege moves the P2 Witchseekers beside the P1 Custodian Guard; engagement zoom x3 frames both rows. T08_before rebuilds the pre-T08 token from the ring specs (no slot ring, one unit-colour band at the old ring's place) - measured pixel-identical (0.0%) in token_swatch to the old build's render of this frame. Tier A: token_swatch diff > 8% (measured 26.1%); glyph_p1 / glyph_p2 (token centres: art, WI* letter) < 1% (measured 0.0%); on the live frame each ring's mid-line is painted in its node's colour; on all 36 tokens SlotRing == the owner's slot colour, FactionRing == the unit's army-data colour from the owner's faction palette, SlotRing.scale > FactionRing.scale, both alpha >= 0.9, both painted; some P1 Custodes token has FactionRing == Custodes gold d9b333 with SlotRing == TEAL; all 8 P2 Witchseekers have SlotRing == MAGENTA and FactionRing == their army colour; the mirror shares inner colours across players, each told apart by the slot ring. Player path: U opens the Army Overview, whose per-unit swatch equals each unit's inner ring on all 36 tokens; picking Pale gold for the Custodian Guard there (swatch -> faction-palette picker) repaints their four inner rings pale gold on screen while the outer rings stay teal; U closes the panel. T08_p1_row / T08_oval_closeup / T08_p2_row frame each army (and an oval base) for the Tier B review.

steps.script:
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_rotation = 0.0
m.view_zoom = 3.0
m.view_offset = Vector2(300, 145) - Vector2(930, 560) / 3.0
m.update_view_transform()
return m.view_zoom
steps.comment: Engagement zoom (x3): P1 Custodian Guard row above the P2 Witchseekers row.
Tier A: regions.token_swatch.diff_pct > 8.0 against the pre-T08 token (measured 26.1%; the old build's own render of this frame diffs the same 26.1%).
Tier B support: the centre of a P1 token (art, number) is untouched by the rings.
Tier B support: the P2 Witchseekers' WI* letter counter is untouched by the rings.
Player path: U opens the army panel (unit colour swatches).
U again closes the army panel.
